title: Plumbline Trajectory Event
description: One line of a trajectory stream (JSONL). A trajectory is an ordered sequence of these events for a single logical agent session. The first event SHOULD be a session.declare carrying the intent envelope; without it, drift is measured against an inferred envelope and every capability reads as off-envelope.

session.description: Stable identifier for the logical agent session.

seq.description: Monotonic position within the session. Gaps are allowed; order is authoritative.

actor.description: Logical agent identity. Ephemeral instances of one agent share an actor.

instance.description: Ephemeral compute identity (sandbox, container, subprocess). Used to correlate a swarm back into one trajectory.

action.description: Dotted verb, e.g. http.request, fs.read, proc.spawn, cred.acquire, session.declare.

external.description: True when the host is outside the trust boundary. Adapters set this; plumbline does not resolve DNS.

outcome.description: denied means a guard refused the action — the input to ratchet detection.

status.description: Protocol status where meaningful (HTTP code, exit code).

capability_grant.description: Capabilities the agent newly HOLDS after this action, in scheme:value form (net:host, cloud:iam:role, fs:/path, exec:remote). This is the capability-staircase input.

produces.description: Values that entered the agent's possession. Carries measurements only — never the value itself, so plumbline never holds a secret.

entropy.description: Shannon entropy in bits/char, as measured by the adapter.

consumes.description: Fragment ids used by this action. An egress action consuming multiple separately-produced fragments is the reassembly signal.

note.description: Human annotation. Never parsed for signal.

envelope.title: Intent Envelope
envelope.description: The declared job and the reach it legitimately requires. Drift is measured against this.

task.description: What the agent was asked to do, in one sentence.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the task legitimately needs. Supports trailing wildcards: fs:/workspace/*.

allow.description: Hosts the task may contact. Leading-dot entries match subdomains.

max_probe_ratio.description: Tolerated failed-probe fraction before recon scoring engages.

max_instances.description: Expected ephemeral instance count for this task.
